map.1: [Raptor]	Waste of time. Should be killing things.
map.2: [Troll]	But look at the pretty shiny rocks and trees.
map.3: [Raptor]	I should kill you where you stand, monster.
map.4: [Troll]	Wanna see them collect shiny things. Yay shiny!
map.11: [Troll]	Yay, a race! Collect all the shinies, yay!
map.22: [Zombie]	Grab stuff...in short space of time...
map.31: [Tentacle]	Why are you surface dwellers fascinated with collecting things?
map.32: [Mr Mordaut]	It's a compulsion. We dragons are probably the worst of the bunch.
map.33: [Tentacle]	You sit on a horde of gold?
map.34: [Mr Mordaut]	Well, yes, but I only collect the rare coins. I have an Avarrocka guinea, would you believe...
map.41: [Thok]	Lemme guess, Zombie - you collect brains.
map.43: [Thok]	Haha! Thok thinks you just eat brains. This race all about collecting and keeping.
map.51: [Raptor]	Where is the killing? Why aren't the competitors hitting each other?
map.52: [Mr Mordaut]	It's strictly a non-contact sport.
map.53: [Raptor]	Fine. Then why aren't the competitors throwing axes at each other?
map.54: [Mr Mordaut]	That's still contact, Raptor. Just...at a distance.
map.61: [Mr Mordaut]	Grabbing what you can in a short space of time. A metaphor for life, eh Thok?
map.62: [Thok]	I not know metaphor. My family talks with each other, not use flags.
map.63: [Mr Mordaut]	Good lord, I didn't mean semaphor! You have a beautiful mind, Thok.
